passage.title: Zib's Moon
passage.text:
Zib lives on a moonbase. The Moon is our closest neighbour in space. It is covered in grey dust and rocks, and it has big round holes called craters, made long ago when space rocks crashed into it.

There is no air on the Moon, so Zib wears a space helmet whenever she goes outside. With no air, there is no wind, so footprints in the dust can stay there for a very long time.

Everything feels much lighter on the Moon. Zib can jump about six times higher than she could on Earth! That is because the Moon's pull, called gravity, is much weaker than Earth's.

The Moon does not make its own light. It shines because the Sun lights it up. One night, the moonbase's star map broke into pieces and floated away. “Without it, the rockets can't find their way!” said Zib.

mission.title: The Scattered Star Map
mission.goal: Help Zib find the Star Map piece so the rockets can fly!

intro.line: Beep bop! Hello, Sparky! The moonbase star map broke into pieces and floated off across the Moon.
Without it, the rockets can't find their way home. One piece landed near the big crater!
Let's bounce over there and find it, Zib!
First, read my story on the Story Stone, so you know all about the Moon.

beats.setup: Hoo! I watched the pieces float away through my telescope. Listen to my message and I'll show you where!
beats.success: Hoo hoo! Correct! This way, across the dust!
beats.fail: Hoo... not quite. Listen again, Sparky.
beats.clue: Professor Hoot saw a piece near the big crater

beats.setup: This moonbase sign spun round when the map floated off. Answer a question about my story to fix it.
beats.success: Beep! The sign points the right way now!
beats.fail: Bop... still spinning. Let's read my story again.
beats.clue: The sign points to the big crater

beats.setup: Rumble... I'm Moonrock Mo. I'm blocking the tunnel. Tell me what my space words mean and I'll float aside.
beats.success: Excellent! Floating out of your way...
beats.fail: Rumble. Not quite. I'm staying put.

beats.setup: The crater bridge lost its panels! Count them with me and we'll build it again.
beats.success: Beep bop! The bridge is fixed. Bounce across!
beats.fail: Oops, the panels floated away. Let's count again.

beats.setup: This space ladder has lost power. Use your science brain to switch it back on!
beats.success: Hoo! The ladder is glowing. Up you go!
beats.fail: Hmm, still no power. Think again.
beats.clue: The space ladder has power again

beats.setup: A space capsule with a pattern lock! Work out what comes next to open it.
beats.success: Click! There's a clue inside: the piece is where the footprints end!
beats.fail: Clunk. Still locked. Look at the pattern again.
beats.clue: The piece is where the footprints end

beats.setup: The airlock door needs a password. Listen carefully and write it!
beats.success: The airlock is open! The star map piece is just ahead!
beats.fail: That's not the password. Let's try again.

finale.line: The footprints end right here, at the big X! Dig, Sparky, dig!
A piece of the Star Map! It's twinkling!
Hoo hoo! Now the rockets can find their way. Take it back to Cosmo Heights!
